name: Research Training Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Four weeks of hands-on biology lab training in downtown Seattle. Teens learn lab skills like PCR and gene editing. They join workshops on college and careers. They present a project of their own.
who_can_apply: Students in grade 10 or 11 who attend high school in Washington and live close enough to travel to downtown Seattle. You need no research experience. You must have a Social Security Number or ITIN to take part.
pay_detail: Free. A $2,000 stipend helps cover transportation and meals.
duration: 4 weeks, weekdays 8:30 am to 3 pm (2027: July 12 to Aug 6)
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 4, 2027 and close Mar 8, 2027 at 5 p.m. Pacific. Late applications are not accepted. Letter of recommendation due Mar 29, 2027. Optional online info session Jan 28, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Ask a teacher, advisor or boss for a letter. You must come in person to a first meeting on May 24, 2027, 4 to 5:30 p.m.
notes: Competitive: the 2027 lab has capacity for 24 students. The IRS treats the stipend as reportable income. Not a medical program and no patient contact. Work permit rule not stated.
